headline: Indian man sentenced to 19 years in plot to kill Sikh leader
pages: A federal judge in Manhattan on Friday sentenced Indian national Nikhil Gupta to 235 months, more than 19 years, for a plot to kill Sikh separatist leader Gurpatwant Singh Pannun in the United States. Gupta pleaded guilty in February to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire and money laundering conspiracy. The judge said he will likely be deported after serving his sentence. Prosecutors say an Indian intelligence officer, Vikash Yadav, directed Gupta in May 2023. The supposed hitman was an undercover DEA officer. India denies involvement and says Yadav no longer works for the government. Pannun, a US citizen, is a spokesman for Sikhs for Justice, which India banned in 2019.
The case strained US-India ties. Source: BBC
